assertions: Both active-plugin orders booted in fresh processes with Rank Math, WooCommerce, ACF, Polylang and Action Scheduler loaded; both Rank Math redirection and shared Action Scheduler tables remained present.
Source capture reported 13 posts, 25 terms, one options file, one media blob, zero pending rows and zero lint findings.
The hostile target preserved its own WooCommerce product, Rank Math title, ACF field value and pending Action Scheduler job while receiving the source products.
The target rebound rank_math_primary_product_cat to local category ids, rebuilt exact WooCommerce lookup prices, carried language-specific ACF values and restored Polylang post/term translation maps.
English and German product HTTP responses contained their own Rank Math title, description, canonical URL, OpenGraph locale and reciprocal hreflang links.
combinations.signature: Exact site and shipped digest pins loaded together. After explicit posts,terms adoption, the first hostile-target apply handled 43 entities (create 9, update 5, adopt 29) with clean canary; the corrected Polylang separate-request lifecycle applied 3 updates; repeat plan reported create 0, update 0, unchanged 43, drift 0, conflict 0, collision 0 and incomplete_apply 0. Source product ids 10/11 became target ids 15/16; source primary product-category ids 23/25 became target ids 29/27 and retained en/de term translations. Woo lookup prices were 29.0000/31.0000, ACF badges were language-specific, the target-only product/SEO/ACF state survived, the source-only scheduler action was absent, and the target-only scheduler action remained. English and German HTTP rendered distinct Rank Math title/description/canonical/OpenGraph output with reciprocal hreflang links.

limitations: The Rank Math redirections module must be enabled through RankMath\Helper::update_modules before capture or target planning; copying rank_math_modules alone does not create its declared tables.

Polylang product/taxonomy translation settings must be written in a fresh request after language creation; the same-request write was discarded by plugin shutdown bookkeeping and produced no source relationship to transfer.

Three WooCommerce provider capabilities were reported unavailable but unselected in this scenario. No provider failure/recovery injection was performed, so this is not evidence for combined rollback completeness.
Rank Math analytics, connected credentials, custom schema, Instant Indexing credentials, Pro/add-ons and releases other than 1.0.277 remain outside this exercise.
The record is a site-adapter exercise. It does not add a Rank Math product manifest, disposition or combined capability claim.

refusals.scenario: An ACF post_object field used the physical name rank_math_title and stored _rank_math_title=field_rmcombo_rank_title on a WooCommerce product.
refusals.signature: Live source capture refused before publication: wprism: post_meta 'rank_math_title' has multiple classification owners: 'acf' via acf (interpreter acf), 'rank-math' via static declaration; dynamic interpreter dispatch cannot resolve cross-manifest ownership. Offline coverage runs the same fact under both manifest pin orders.
